title: fix(selector): makes component as uncontrolled component

comments.body: This introduces a bug! If you press the back button, the value of the select won't be updated anymore.
@bobylito Can you tell us what is the difference between a controlled and uncontrolled component? I couldn't understand it from the docs.
So do we do something to solve what @bobylito said here?

We should open a new issue for tracking this bug, with a simple repro case (I did not get if it was pressing backspace in the input, or in the webpage -to go to previous page- that triggered the issue).

cc @bobylito
